newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich sees close vote on U.S. budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich sees close vote on U.S. budget amendment.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Thursday the vote on the constitutional amendment to require a balanced budget was likely to be "very close" in the House next month.
"This is going to be a very close vote," the Republican from Georgia said at a media briefing. House Republican leaders said the vote on the amendment was scheduled for Feb. 26.
Last year's vote on the amendment, which passed the House but was defeated in the Senate, "is no predictor of what will happen this year," Gingrich said.
House Majority Whip Tom DeLay, a Republican from Texas, said the vote would be the first big test of bipartisanship in this Congress.
"As the majority whip of the House, I know where the votes are. And I can tell you that we will need a lot of votes from the Democrats if the balanced budget amendment is going to pass," he said.
